1. DATA COLLECTION
 MacroKap collects minimal data required for operation. This includes device identity for pairing (hashed ANDROID_ID) and optional analytics if enabled in settings.

 2. NETWORK SECURITY
 Connections are secured using cryptographic handshakes (RSA/AES) when secure mode is enabled. Your server fingerprint is stored locally.

 3. THIRD PARTY SERVICES
 We use AdMob for advertisements and Firebase for analytics. These services may collect data as governed by their respective privacy policies.

 4. DATA RETENTION
 We do not store your macro data on our servers. All macro configurations are stored on your own desktop server.
